tools.name: start_flow_task
tools.description: Use at the start of a non-trivial task. Checks your proposed outcome and definition of done (DoD) against Flow's contract rules, chooses the quick or full path, and returns DoD item IDs, a signed contract token and the first step. Computes only; stores nothing. Save the token in your goal file.

tools.name: get_flow_step
tools.description: Use when you need guidance on a Flow stage, an event (e.g. blocked), a module (e.g. nobrainer-review), or a PR's Definition of Done or readiness (topic pr_dod). Returns up to six rules quoted from the pinned release, with their source. With a token, event resume also returns a goal block.

tools.name: check_flow_evidence
tools.description: Use after running a check. Validates one to four evidence records against DoD items in the contract token: exit codes, test counts in the output, hashes, URL status and evidence level. It cannot see your machine; it checks structure and consistency only. Returns verdicts and an updated token.

tools.name: check_flow_done
tools.description: Use before saying a task is done. Returns DONE only when every DoD item has accepted, current evidence, DONE_WITH_GAPS when the rest are listed in unchecked with a reason, otherwise NOT_DONE with the exact missing items.

tools.name: draft_flow_handoff
tools.description: Use after check_flow_done. Returns a short final-report skeleton from the done receipt: delivered outcome, proof per DoD item, what was not checked, decisions left to the user and the next action.

tools.name: recommend_flow_model
tools.description: Use when picking a model for a Flow task: top-3 from a pinned NoBrainer benchmark snapshot, no invented scores.
